title: Crispy Hash Browns with Potato and Knobby Onions
description: A simple breakfast recipe featuring crispy hash browns, sautéed knobby onions, and diced potatoes. Perfect for a weekend brunch.

ingredients.name: 2 large potatoes, peeled
ingredients.notes: Use a high-starch potato variety for the best results

ingredients.name: 1 large knobby onion, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Crisp up the onions quickly to prevent burning

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil with a high smoke point

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon salt
ingredients.notes: Use flaky sea salt for added texture and flavor

ingredients.name: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground pepper enhances the dish's flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes and thinly sliced onions.
Add the vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl. Toss to coat the potatoes and onions evenly.
Transfer the potato and onion mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the hash browns are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to break up the hash browns and serve hot.
